process_scope.scope: all ready-census process members; no later fork/clone in retained warmup+measurement
process_scope.measurement_scope_equivalence: unmarked process members have zero retired UOPs and observed owner ticks

mapping_limitations: CPU0 system execution is excluded from replay
gem5 task scheduling is a captured physical stream; no OS scheduler replay
FastSim replay cannot reconstruct missing wrong-path and speculative activity exactly
FastSim store model does not reconstruct gem5 committed-line merging and credit reclamation; buffer mode is diagnostic
MITE/DSB/MS have a retired-path calendar with one-macro lookahead; shared STLB/ITLB timing is not represented
SPR SIMD and split-store OpClasses retain their identities, but captured retirement order cannot reproduce all speculative resource contention
Ruby network ordering and DRAM refresh are approximations
initial PTE state unknown for multi-CR3; dynamic translations retain observed identities
strict task-active coverage is unavailable; native and simulated cache-PMU event semantic equivalence is not certified
DRAM refresh uses this run tREFI/tRFC and clock, but its native phase at FST entry is unavailable; relative model origin zero is an explicit phase approximation
Retired-only frontend deliberately excludes native speculative activity
Source service calendars use one-macro lookahead; native cross-macro atomic delivery and full backend feedback are not claimed equivalent
DSB identity uses functional code bytes/context and ASID; native physical code lease and ITLB/STLB are not fully represented
FastSim shared-port arbitration is fixed-order, not gem5 round-robin; FU opClass issue intervals and BTB hit latency remain model approximations
Ruby L1/L2 hardware prefetchers are enabled in gem5 but not replayed in FastSim; cache and DRAM request populations can differ
controller TBEs are represented by FastSim MSHRs as a capacity proxy, not proven identical
FastSim serial/relief and buffer/prepare choices do not reproduce gem5 committed-line merging, shared credit or four ordered in-flight lines
BTB state evolution, frontend timing and wrong-path activity cannot be reconstructed exactly from the retired FST
